text: Up to 212 gigabytes! That's how much free space GTA 6 needs... and it's not even out yet.
And the twist? The box in stores doesn't even have a disc!
Rockstar opened preloads on November 10th, for anyone with a digital pre-order on PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series.
Launch day is Thursday, November 19th... after two delays, from 2025, then May 2026.
The physical edition is literally a download code in a box, so you still need that massive download.
And Rockstar says it targets 30 frames per second on consoles, even on PS5 Pro.
Price check? 80 dollars in the US... but 9,800 yen in Japan, lowkey a lot cheaper.
And Take-Two's boss reportedly says pre-orders are running far beyond expectations.
My take? A box with no disc is giving digital-only era... but nobody's skipping this one, no cap.
